exposure: Fetal growth restriction (FGR), Cerebroplacental ratio (CPR), Umbilical-cerebral ratio (UCR), Cerebro-placental-uterine ratio (CPUR)
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcomes: Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes, preterm birth <37 weeks, NICU admission, fetal distress, emergency cesarean section
cohort: 100 women with singleton pregnancies complicated by FGR between 28 and 36.8 weeks of gestation.
finding: Lower CPUR was significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by FGR.
